card.name: Population or disease words after in/for
card.fires_on: Words naming the patient group or disease, such as patients, MS, RA, right after in, for or the. Also fires partway through words like Precautions and PATIENTS in label headings.

modes.label: Patients or disease after a linking word
modes.description: The word patients or a disease abbreviation (MS, RA) follows in, for or the.
modes.example: No dosage adjustment is needed for<< patients>> with mild or moderate renal impairment

modes.label: Partway through heading words
modes.description: A middle piece of a capitalised or long word in a warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PAT<<IENT>>S WITH DEMENTIA-RELATED PS
